_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. Everything in config.json stays on the practice machine — never commit it.
_port_comment: Local port the bridge listens on. The tunnel forwards a public URL to this.
_token_comment: Shared secret. The app sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"

mysql._enabled_comment: Open Dental engine. Fill this in and the app's Open Dental connector routes through this bridge (patients, appointments, insurance, practice sync, task analyzer, agent write-back). Remove the whole mysql block to disable. NOTE: /od/query runs whatever SQL the app sends, including writes — the token is database-level power, so keep it secret; you can point user at a least-privilege MySQL account if you like.
mysql._host_comment: MySQL / MariaDB server. 127.0.0.1 when the bridge runs on the Open Dental server itself.
mysql._database_comment: The Open Dental database name ('opendental' by default; the demo install uses 'demo').

odbc._dsn_comment: Name of a 64-bit Windows ODBC DSN pointing at the Dentrix c-treeACE server. Leave empty to use the dsnLess block instead.

dsnLess._driver_comment: Exact driver name as shown in Windows ODBC Data Sources (64-bit) > Drivers tab. probe.js lists candidates if you are unsure.
dsnLess._server_comment: Host of the Dentrix database server. 'localhost' when the bridge runs on the Dentrix server itself.
dsnLess._service_comment: c-treeACE SQL port. Dentrix is reported to use 5712 (FairCom default is 6597). Confirm with the practice IT or probe different ports.
dsnLess._uid_comment: c-treeACE SQL login. FairCom ships ADMIN/ADMIN by default; Dentrix may have changed it.

schema._comment: Map real Dentrix table/column names here from the probe report (probe-report.json). Until every patient table+id+phone column is filled, /patients returns 503 by design.
